description: This file manages plugin conversation bindings, including approval workflows, session management, and event dispatching within a plugin system. It handles external dependencies, approval caching, and binding state management.

methods.name: getPluginBindingGlobalState
methods.description: Returns the global state object for plugin binding management.

methods.name: resolveApprovalsPath
methods.description: Resolves the file path for the plugin binding approvals JSON file.

methods.name: normalizeChannel
methods.description: Normalizes a channel string to lowercase and trimmed.

methods.name: normalizeConversation
methods.description: Normalizes conversation parameters, trimming and setting defaults.

methods.name: toConversationRef
methods.description: Converts normalized conversation parameters to a ConversationRef, resolving via channel plugin if available.

methods.name: buildApprovalScopeKey
methods.description: Builds a unique key for approval scope based on plugin root, channel, and account ID.

methods.name: buildPluginBindingSessionKey
methods.description: Creates a session key for plugin binding, hashed for uniqueness.

methods.name: isLegacyPluginBindingRecord
methods.description: Checks if a record is a legacy plugin binding record based on target session key prefixes.

methods.name: buildApprovalInteractiveReply
methods.description: Builds an interactive reply payload for plugin binding approval.

methods.name: createApprovalRequestId
methods.description: Generates a compact unique ID for approval requests.

methods.name: loadApprovalsFromDisk
methods.description: Loads the approvals data from disk, with validation and fallback.

methods.name: saveApprovals
methods.description: Saves the approvals data to disk atomically.

methods.name: getApprovals
methods.description: Retrieves the current approvals cache, loading from disk if necessary.

methods.name: hasPersistentApproval
methods.description: Checks if a persistent approval exists for given plugin root, channel, and account.

methods.name: addPersistentApproval
methods.description: Adds a new persistent approval entry and saves to disk.

methods.name: buildBindingMetadata
methods.description: Constructs metadata for a plugin binding.

methods.name: isPluginOwnedBindingMetadata
methods.description: Type guard to check if metadata is plugin owned.

methods.name: isPluginOwnedSessionBindingRecord
methods.description: Checks if a record is a plugin owned session binding record.

methods.name: toPluginConversationBinding
methods.description: Converts a binding record to a PluginConversationBinding object.

methods.name: bindConversationNow
methods.description: Creates a plugin conversation binding record and returns the binding.

methods.name: buildApprovalMessage
methods.description: Generates a message string requesting plugin binding approval.

methods.name: resolvePluginBindingDisplayName
methods.description: Returns a display name for a plugin binding, preferring pluginName.

methods.name: buildDetachHintSuffix
methods.description: Builds a suffix string for detach hints if provided.

methods.name: buildPluginBindingUnavailableText
methods.description: Returns a message indicating plugin is not loaded.

methods.name: buildPluginBindingDeclinedText
methods.description: Returns a message indicating plugin did not handle the message.

methods.name: buildPluginBindingErrorText
methods.description: Returns a message indicating an error occurred in plugin handling.

methods.name: hasShownPluginBindingFallbackNotice
methods.description: Checks if fallback notice has been shown for a binding ID.

methods.name: markPluginBindingFallbackNoticeShown
methods.description: Marks that fallback notice has been shown for a binding ID.

methods.name: buildPendingReply
methods.description: Builds a reply payload for pending plugin binding requests.

methods.name: encodeCustomIdValue
methods.description: Encodes a string for use in custom IDs.

methods.name: decodeCustomIdValue
methods.description: Decodes a string from custom ID encoding.

methods.name: buildPluginBindingApprovalCustomId
methods.description: Constructs a custom ID string for plugin binding approval decisions.

methods.name: parsePluginBindingApprovalCustomId
methods.description: Parses a custom ID string into an approval action.

methods.name: requestPluginConversationBinding
methods.description: Handles plugin binding requests, including auto-approval and pending approval workflows.

methods.name: getCurrentPluginConversationBinding
methods.description: Retrieves the current plugin binding for a conversation if it exists.

methods.name: detachPluginConversationBinding
methods.description: Detaches a plugin binding from a conversation.

methods.name: resolvePluginConversationBindingApproval
methods.description: Resolves an approval decision for a plugin binding request, creating or denying the binding.

methods.name: dispatchPluginConversationBindingResolved
methods.description: Dispatches an event when a plugin binding resolution occurs.

methods.name: notifyPluginConversationBindingResolved
methods.description: Notifies registered handlers of plugin binding resolution events.

methods.name: buildPluginBindingResolvedText
methods.description: Generates a user-facing message based on plugin binding resolution result.
